notes: kb/Work PB322 determination A LANDED (w1013m). The default sharing mode is a function of the OPEN mode: OPEN INPUT establishes SHARING WITH READ ONLY and OPEN OUTPUT / I-O / EXTEND establish SHARING WITH NO OTHER (FileRegistry.ImplementorDefaultSharing, read once in SharedOpenAttempt: phrase ?? clause ?? default). Every arbitration is Table19.Conflicts, a plain lookup of the printed table; the null 'undetermined' mode, its universal quantifier and FileRegistry.Conflicts are deleted. The GnuCOBOL basis (rule 1) is the cross-run-unit lock posture (shared for input, exclusive otherwise). Golden 2002/pb322_default_sharing_by_open_mode pins the pairs (INPUT+INPUT 00/00, INPUT then I-O/EXTEND/OUTPUT 61, I-O then INPUT/I-O 61, LOCK MODE-only SELECT the same default, free again after the readers close); unit:OpenTable19Tests.ImplementorDefault_IsAFunctionOfTheOpenMode pins the function and its consequences over all 16 mode pairs. Band 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB6130): the item documents the sharing mode an implementor establishes when neither a SHARING phrase nor a SHARING clause is written (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR23; §2002:14.8.26.3 GR22; §2002:B.1 items 58 and 104). ANSI X3.23-1985 has no sharing mode and no such item in its Implementor-Defined Language Element List, so no 1985 text leaves this latitude. At --std 85 there is no sharing mode to document: 1985 keys I-O status 41 to the physical file (§1985:II.2; §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR5; §1985:VII.1.3.5), so a second file connector's OPEN of a physical file another connector of the run unit holds open answers 41 (kb/Work PB6161, the owner's decision of 2026-11-24, which replaced PB670's option (i)). That is 1985's own rule, not this item's latitude.
